title: refactor(core, plugin-security): the external organization-scope reading moves to core's security module, so service-automation no longer loads plugin-security at run time
body:
Fixes #32358

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把"外部对象声明了哪种组织范围"这一判断（`externalOrganizationScopeOf`、它的 Layer 0 投影、它依赖的幻影锚点判断，以及统一的补救文案 `EXTERNAL_SCOPE_REMEDY`）从 `plugin-security` 原样搬到 `@objectstack/core` 的 security 模块；`plugin-security` 在原模块路径和包入口继续导出同名绑定（转出口），同步拉取改从 core 引入。
- 为什么改：sync-in 拉取只为调用一个纯函数、读一句文案，就让 `@objectstack/service-automation` 在运行时依赖整个安全插件包；这个判断用到的东西本来都在插件之下（契约评审 N1）。
- 风险与回滚：代码逐字节搬运，行为不变，只有一份实现；风险在于 core 的公开导出面多了六个名字（因此声明 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/external-organization-scope.ts`（搬过来的实现）、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/external-organization-scope.ts`（改为转出口）、`packages/services/service-automation/package.json`（`plugin-security` 回到 devDependencies）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/security/external-organization-scope.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全绿（与原插件里的同一组用例逐字一致）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`** gains `packages/core/src/security/external-organization-scope.ts`, exported from the security module (so from the package entry): `externalOrganizationScopeOf`, `externalOrganizationScopeIsUndeclared`, `declaredForeignTenantField`, `hasPhantomTenantAnchor`, the `ExternalOrganizationScope` type and `EXTERNAL_SCOPE_REMEDY`. Every definition is the plugin's text, byte for byte (compared function by function against the merge base `326453eb9`). It composes only what core already depends on: `isFederatedObject` (core), `isTenancyDisabled` (`@objectstack/spec/data`) and `TENANT_SCOPE_FIELD_DEF` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`, already a run-time dependency of core; metadata-core depends on spec and zod only, so no cycle).
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`**: `external-organization-scope.ts` re-exports those bindings from core and keeps everything that is the plugin's own (the boot refusal, its error class, the write-wall refusal, the post-boot warning). `federated-phantom-anchors.ts` keeps its module docblock and re-exports `hasPhantomTenantAnchor` and `isFederatedObject` from core. `security-plugin.ts` imports the two bindings it reads for the Layer 0 input from core. The package entry exports the same names as before.
- **`@objectstack/service-automation`**: `datasource-pull.ts` imports the reading from `@objectstack/core` (the import line only, so it merges cleanly with the in-flight sync-in slice 3 branch, which edits the docblock and code around it). `@objectstack/plugin-security` moves back to `devDependencies`, where it sat before the sync-in slice 2 PR (the test suites still boot `SecurityPlugin`); the manifest blob is the pre-slice-2 one again. Lockfile updated to match.
- Why `hasPhantomTenantAnchor` moved too: the reading calls it (an external object's own `organization_id` is `walled` only when it is not the platform's injected anchor), and it is the only path by which the reading reads `TENANT_SCOPE_FIELD_DEF`. Leaving it in the plugin would have meant a second copy in core.

## Tests

- The reading's thirteen cases moved verbatim to `packages/core/src/security/external-organization-scope.test.ts` (the `describe` block is byte-identical to the one removed from the plugin).
- The plugin's `external-organization-scope.test.ts` gains a re-export pin: the module path, `federated-phantom-anchors.ts` and the package entry serve core's bindings by identity, plus one case reading an undeclared external object through the plugin's module path. The boot door, Layer 0 door and write-wall cases are unchanged.
- No ablation: a pure move changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- `datasource-pull.ts` still says, in its module docblock, that the scope "is read by plugin-security's `externalOrganizationScopeOf`". Left untouched on purpose: the sync-in slice 3 branch rewrites the neighbouring docblock lines, and the dispatch held this edit to the import line. The sentence's carrier is that slice.
- No ADR anchor was added for the new core file; the existing anchor on the plugin file (ADR-0015, ADR-0095) still holds, and the core file names both ADRs in its header.
- The branch is 13 commits behind `main`; `git merge-tree` against `main` at `d7c3d44ecd` is clean. The only overlap is `packages/core/src/security/index.ts`, where `main` added one export in a different block.
